comment: IOS-XR 24.2.2 ASR 9902 chassis model. Component names, types, parents and descriptions follow what an ASR 9902 reports; optics are data-sheet parts; serials and MACs are synthetic. The logical interface and VLAN subinterface kinds follow what an ASR 9902 reports; which ones exist, their ifTypes (ieee8023adLag, propVirtual, softwareLoopback, other, l2vlan) and speeds are chosen, not captured. Edit this file and run make gen-xr-chassis.
